To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

regional trade and value chains in Southern Africa are expanding rapidly and diversifying in composition; regional value chains are increasingly important for regional industrial development and the expansion of regional markets; and the long term sustainability and success of Southern African regional integration depends on the extent to which it can facilitate regional industrial development and regional linkages.
regional value chains have been expanding in Southern Africa, and are a key driver of regional trade.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of regional value chain in promoting regional integration in Southern African.
the following questions: How are regional value chains evolving and what are the implications for regional integration?
the role of regional value chain dynamics in fostering regional industrial development and integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
regional value chains are a significant feature of Southern African integration and that regional industrial policy should take this into account.

regional value chains are an important part of the regional integration agenda in Southern Africa, and that regional integration in Southern African can be further enhanced by building on the regional value chains that already exist.
regional value chains and the associated industrial development opportunities are not yet fully recognised in the regional integration process in Southern Africa.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Southern Africa Development Community is a good example of how regional integration can be used to support industrialisation and economic development.
regional value chain analysis is a useful analytical tool in the context of regional integration.
there is a need for regional industrial policy to be more explicitly focused on regional value chains, and for this to be supported by a more coherent regional trade policy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
regional integration in Africa is not just about trade liberalisation and regional market expansion but also about industrialisation and industrial policy.
there is an opportunity to use regional value chains to promote regional industrialisation.
regional industrial policies can play an important role in promoting industrial upgrading and diversification in the region.
